svg.title: TONA OIS forward curves, 21 Oct 2026
svg.desc: Instantaneous forward rates of the TONA curve under quad-smooth fitting, flat-forward bootstrap and linear-zero bootstrap, and the quad-smooth curve's instantaneous, 3-month and 1-year forwards and zero rates, 0 to 30 years. Values in docs/forward_curves.csv.
svg.text: One set of TONA OIS quotes (21 Oct 2026), three curves
Instantaneous forward rate. All three reprice every benchmark exactly; only the quad-smooth fit keeps the forward continuous.
Ticks on the axis mark the OIS benchmark maturities
Quad-smooth curve: forward rates by tenor
Instantaneous, 3-month and 1-year simple forwards starting at each date, with the zero curve for reference.
